episode_summary: This episode of 'Keeping It Real' with DJ Paris focuses on leveraging AI to uncover hidden business opportunities within existing contacts. By implementing specific AI strategies, real estate agents can improve their prospecting efforts, streamline client communication, and ultimately increase their business. The episode provides actionable insights and a preview of an upcoming webinar designed to teach these AI techniques.
